dict.string: Relay can read events from calendars you explicitly select to help with your requests. macOS grants full calendar access; Relay does not create or change events.
Relay uses the microphone only when you start voice input. Audio is processed by on-device speech recognition; unsupported local recognition is refused.
Relay requests speech permission for optional on-device dictation into a reviewable transcript. It requires on-device recognition and never falls back to hosted speech recognition.
